errors.evidence: The description fails to clarify that the Y-axis, with its scale from 0.00 to 6.00 trillion dollars, applies only to the blue area chart and not to the orange line. The percentage values for the orange line are given as labels and do not correspond to the Y-axis scale.

The description states that the orange line shows a decreasing trend. This is an over-generalization, as the trend is not consistently decreasing; the value increases from 17% in 2020 to 18% in 2021, and again from 13% in 2022 to 16% in 2023.
